nodes.name: Every 6h
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 3: health dead-man's-switch for the COMMODITY hosted ClickUp MCP (https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp) that all four tier agents use for caller-scoped discovery. ClickUp operates the endpoint (we cannot fix it), but if it is down EVERY scoped discovery silently degrades to no-discovery for every user — this surfaces that within ~6h instead of at the next real task. Mirrors Image MCP Health Monitor (v1).

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for Definition-of-Done verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs (a Schedule Trigger cannot be fired over the n8n API). No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Probe ClickUp MCP
nodes.notes: GET the ClickUp MCP's PUBLIC OAuth Authorization-Server metadata (https://mcp.clickup.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server). This endpoint needs NO token (n8n cannot read a per-user MCP-OAuth token out of the Anthropic Vault — by design), yet its reachability is a valid liveness signal for the same service that serves /mcp. 2xx -> healthy (service up); any non-2xx OR network/timeout routes to the error output (onError) -> CRITICAL. Per-user auth CORRECTNESS is NOT tested here — it is re-validated per session at run time (the agent surfaces a tool error) and by the Block-5 cross-department gate; this switch only catches a down/unreachable ClickUp MCP service.

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy path. Silent on purpose — a healthy probe must NOT post to the Alerts task every 6h.

nodes.name: Alert ClickUp MCP Down
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) when the ClickUp MCP service is unreachable or returns non-2xx. While down, all four tier agents lose caller-scoped ClickUp discovery (they degrade to no-discovery, surfaced per run). Check status.clickup.com and that mcp.clickup.com resolves; this is a ClickUp-side outage we cannot fix, only route around (the lane still serves task-bound pre-gather).

value.message: Sonda ClickUp MCP nie powiodla sie — hostowany serwer MCP (mcp.clickup.com) niedostepny lub zwrocil blad.
value.details: =Blad: {{ (($json.error || {}).message) || $json.error || JSON.stringify($json).slice(0,300) }}. Endpoint: https://mcp.clickup.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server. Gdy ClickUp MCP jest niedostepny, wszystkie 4 agenty traca zakresowane wyszukiwanie kontekstu w ClickUp (degraduja do braku discovery, sygnalizowane per sesja). Sprawdz status.clickup.com oraz rozwiazywanie nazwy mcp.clickup.com. To awaria po stronie ClickUp — mozna ja tylko obejsc (lane nadal serwuje pre-gather zwiazany z zadaniem).
